title: Monotonicity of the mean
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $u,v:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $u(x)\le v(x)$ for every input $x$. Then the uniform mean of $u$ is at most the uniform mean of $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ and $v$ are real-valued functions on the sign cube
